title: SpeechSay
description: Speak with the head's own voice (on-device text to speech), with the mouth moving to the audio and the words as a subtitle. `segments` run in order: `say` speaks text, `emotion` changes the expression right there (the voice follows: brighter for happy, calmer for sad or focused), `action` adds a laugh, a sigh, a pause or a blink, `gesture` is passed on as a cue (`speech` topic) for a body to nod, shake or tilt. Answered at once with the utterance id; progress comes on the `speech` topic (`say_start`, `cue`, `say_end`). By default a new utterance interrupts the one playing. While listening (`speech.listen`), recognition pauses while the head speaks, so it does not hear itself.

voice.description: A voice identifier, or a language such as `en-US` or `sv-SE` (the best installed voice for it). Default `en-US`.

subtitle.description: Show the words on screen as they are spoken. Default true.

interrupt.description: Stop what is being said now (default true); false queues after it.

emotion.description: An expression from `face.list`; it holds until the next one.

action.description: `laugh`: a short laugh with the laughing expression, then back to the expression before. `sigh`: a sigh. `pause`: silence for `seconds`. `blink`: blink once.

gesture.description: Sent as a `cue` on the `speech` topic at this point, for a body that moves the head.

utterance_id.description: Matches `utterance_id` in the `speech` topic events for this utterance.
